title: Dell, HPE and NetApp Stocks Slump After Downgrades on Worries About AI Spending
key_facts: Barclays lowered Dell, HPE and NetApp to 'equal weight' from 'overweight' on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026.
Barclays said memory-part shortages raised prices and propped up revenues.
Analysts 'don't see a meaningful AI inflection yet'.
Sales growth could slow once prices normalise or fall.
Dell has roughly quadrupled this year; HPE and NetApp have more than doubled.
quote_evidence: Barclays downgraded Dell, HPE, and NetApp over concerns about enterprise AI spending growth.
The analysts said higher prices have propped up revenues, and that they "don't see a meaningful AI inflection yet."
why_it_matters_hint: Part of the recent rise in these stocks came from higher memory prices, not from lasting AI demand, in Barclays' view.
